strongs_1890.strongs_def: to pull off, i.e. (by implication) to expose (as by stripping); specifically, to betroth (as if a surrender); figuratively, to carp at, i.e. defame; to spend the winter
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; also  denominative (from H2779 (חֹרֶף))
strongs_1890.kjv_def: betroth, blaspheme, defy, jeopard, rail, reproach, upbraid.
